title: cmux proof record, version 1
description: What a pre-PR verify loop ran on a pull request's exact head. scripts/ci/proof_record.py reads and writes it; README.md beside this file describes it.

head_sha.description: the commit the runs built: the PR's head when the record was posted

base_sha.description: the merge base of the head and its base branch

merged_base.description: the loop merged the moved base into the head before it ran

selection.description: the suite's selector output (FlowSuite select_flows.py for iOS)

step.description: the cmux-ci step id; `cmux-ci artifact STEP OUT` fetches its evidence

baseline.description: where the compared captures came from: {source, pr, sha, merge_commit, step}

visual.description: what a visual-change tier checks: {screens, baselined, baseline_source (nightly, merged or none), changed, video, diffed}

tool.description: the loop that wrote it, at its commit
